name: rosetta-generate-lower-case-ascii-alphabet
code:
use default

let letters = ('a'::'z') |> collect()

let last = letters.count - 1

write_line(letters |> join(""))
write_line("{letters.count} letters, {letters[0]} to {letters[last]}")
